{{Top|leg}}
A '''credit voucher''' was a popular form of [[Currency/Legends|payment]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Customers could use credit vouchers to pay for rides in [[Metrocab Robo-Hack Landspeeder]]s by inserting the voucher into a [[Dataport/Legends|dataport]] once reaching their destination.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
